question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
C = \begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -8 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $C$ is a matrix for which all entries above and below the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
C = \begin{bmatrix}-7 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -8 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is a diagonal matrix.

question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
C = \begin{bmatrix}7 & 0 & -7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $C$ is a matrix for which all entries below the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
C = \begin{bmatrix}7 & 0 & -7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is an upper triangular matrix.

It is not a lower triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element above the diagonal: ${c}_{13}=-7\ne 0.$
